text.zh: 西蒙斯基金会与Anthropic、OpenAI合作推出1500万美元AI数学项目
text.en: Simons Foundation Launches $15M Effort to Help Mathematicians Navigate AI Era

text.zh: 西蒙斯基金会宣布与Anthropic和OpenAI合作，推出总计1500万美元的资金和资源项目，帮助数学家应对AI在数学领域的迅速崛起。这一举措将通过开放提案支持工作坊和倡议，帮助研究人员评估AI辅助成果、学习使用新工具，并共同制定AI使用的集体标准。
text.en: The Simons Foundation announced a new set of initiatives in partnership with Anthropic and OpenAI to commit $15 million in combined funding and resources. The effort will help the mathematics community navigate the rapid rise of artificial intelligence in the field through workshops and initiatives supporting researchers in evaluating AI-assisted results, learning and using new tools, and shaping collective standards for AI use.

text.zh: 项目由数学社区驱动，强调集体合作而非单一机构主导。西蒙斯基金会长期致力于支持机器学习在科学中的应用，包括资助Lean证明助理的开发，这为数学家提供了革命性工具并使AI辅助证明成为可能。该基金会还举办了工作坊、讲座和协作，促进数学家们探讨AI在该领域的角色。
text.en: The awards and resources will be community-driven and leverage the foundation’s decades-long dedication to supporting and championing mathematics. The foundation was an early backer of machine learning for science, including funding the development of the Lean proof assistant, which has revolutionized how mathematicians work and made AI-assisted proofs possible. Additionally, the foundation has convened workshops, lectures and collaborations that have brought mathematicians together to explore and discuss AI’s role in the field.

text.zh: “现在是时候将数学作为一个整体来审视——不仅仅是一系列证明和定理，而是由人类好奇心驱动的集体理解，”西蒙斯基金会总裁David Spergel表示。这项计划的目标是支持数学社区自身讨论AI工具的评估、采用和使用方式。
text.en: “As artificial intelligence rapidly reshapes the research landscape, we want to help the mathematical community come together and forge the best path forward,” says Simons Foundation President David Spergel. “Now is the time to look at mathematics as a whole — not as a collection of proofs and theorems, but as a collective understanding driven by human curiosity.” The goal of the program is to support the mathematics community.

text.zh: 目前项目的主要限制在于需等待社区提案提交以确定具体支持的方向，而开放性讨论也可能引发关于AI伦理和影响的进一步辩论。
text.en: The awards and resources will be community-driven, and the program is in its early stages; specific initiatives will be determined through open calls for proposals. An important limitation is that implementation depends on community proposals and participation.
